name: Deep End — Pressing Against the Rim
summary: Stacey's control technique: use a hand grip to consciously press against the cervix rim area, keeping awareness and control so you don't accidentally bump into the cervix itself unexpectedly.
detailed_description: Pressing against the rim is about control and consent. By using a hand grip to deliberately press on the rim area around the cervix, you stay aware of exactly how deep contact is going and avoid accidentally bouncing into the cervix itself—keeping the experience intentional and comfortable for everyone.

3. Maintain awareness of how deep contact is reaching.
